notes: "This real public fixture moves a page from position 2 to position 4 in a six-page Main. Its short Slide ID, C014, stays the same. Position describes the current ordering; identity connects the content, history and Presentation references. When collaborating, name the page by its short ID rather than relying only on a changing position. These are actual before and after Editor status strips."

designIntent.purpose: Distinguish stable page identity from its changing position.
keep: Keep actual interface pixels, source attribution and the demonstrated behavior.
Keep stable page identity, editable objects and the correct author watermark.
